app.name: Alfie's Adventure
app.short_description: Real Alfie! Three levels, poo powers, sounds and enemies.
app.long_description: Help Alfie explore the garden, park and sunny beach. Find 6 bones per level, collect tennis balls and silly poo speed-ups, and bark at enemies. Sideways Wii Remote: D-pad move, 2 jump, 1 bark, + restart, HOME exit.
